verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents string-based Labels that can be attached to messages and threads, allow/block Lists for filtering senders, and multiple inboxes. None of these is a documented capability that splits an inbox into prioritized streams such as important, team, newsletters, or calendar invites. These are developer building blocks or adjacent filtering controls, and a developer would have to build the categorization and priority-ordered triage themselves, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can split my inbox into focused streams — important, team, newsletters, calendar invites — so triage happens in priority order, not arrival order
